question: The first ICC T20 Cricket World Cup was held in the year _______.
solution:
correct answer is __**2007 .**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** T20 World Cup, first played in 2007**, is an international cricket championship, usually held **once every two years**.
 
• The inaugural men’s twenty20 edition, featuring **12 teams, was held in South Africa.**
 
• The Indian cricket team, led by **M.S Dhoni**, were c**rowned the champions** after** beating Pakistan by five runs in the final at Johannesburg**.
 
• ** New Zealand** are the only finalist in the men’s T20 World Cup history to **not win the trophy.**
 
• **England became the first team** to simultaneously hold both men’s World Cups - the** 2019 ODI World Cup and the 2022 T20 World Cup.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• T20 world cup winner:
 
 
• 2014** Sri Lanka won** and** India runner up.**
 
• 2021 **Australia**** won **and New Zealand runner up.
